name: Paprika Recipe Manager
tagline: The core loop is small enough for a capable coding agent to produce a useful local version in one sitting. For Paprika Recipe Manager, store recipes, plan meals, create grocery lists, and keep data in a portable local database. The hard boundary is native apps, browser capture, sync, grocery workflow, and long-term maintenance, plus sync, integrations, and household adoption.
